items.title: History looms but Hazlewood eyeing bigger picture in Bangladesh Tests
items.summary: Personal and team glory could await the returning quick Josh Hazlewood as he and his teammates prepare for an unprecedented period of Test cricket in the upcoming two-Test series against Bangladesh, starting next month.

items.title: Shanto has ‘full faith’ in Tigers’ squad against Australia
items.summary: Bangladesh Test captain Najmul Hossain Shanto began Thursday's pre-tour press conference in an unusual way, turning the tables on journalists by asking what they expected from Bangladesh in the upcoming two-Test series against Australia.

items.title: Shanto: Bangladesh fast bowlers will 'give Australia a tough time'
items.summary: Shanto also welcomed Australia's decision to field a full-strength squad, seeing it as a sign of the "respect" Bangladesh have earned

items.title: Hazlewood: I'd love to play more with Scotty Boland
items.summary: Hazlewood has changed his preparation heading towards the series against Bangladesh having missed eight of Australia's last 14 Tests through injury

items.title: Tamim hopeful despite no update on India series
items.summary: The series, originally scheduled for 2025 before being postponed to September this year, remains uncertain amid strained relations between the two neighbouring countries.

items.title: Litton Das named Bangladesh's new ODI captain
items.summary: He takes over from Mehidy, who the BCB hopes will be able to regain top form without added responsibility

items.title: Litton replaces Miraz as ODI captain
items.summary: Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) president Tamim Iqbal confirmed at a press conference in Mirpur on Wednesday that Litton Das has been appointed ODI captain, adding the 50-over format to his T20I captaincy and replacing Mehidy Hasan Miraz.

items.title: Bashar regrets Rana's absence from Australia tour despite being 'extra cautious'
items.summary: Bangladesh chief selector said Rana's side strain was "unfortunate", and that it's "hard to keep fast bowlers free of injuries"

items.title: Bangladesh recall Soumya Sarkar for first Test against Australia
items.summary: Jaker Ali and Musfik Hasan were also picked, while Mehidy Hasan Miraz and Taskin Ahmed returned after being rested for the Zimbabwe Test

items.title: Nahid Rana ruled out of Test series against Australia
items.summary: Shoriful Islam and Litton Das will also miss the first Test but could be available for the second after rehabilitation
